title: My Take on AI in Software Engineering
subtitle: How AI is transforming our craft — from rapid full-stack synthesis to crafting beautiful, enterprise-grade interfaces.
quote: AI accelerates full-stack engineering, freeing architects from boilerplate so we can focus on what matters most: creating beautiful, intuitive, and rock-solid enterprise applications.

principles.title: The Unstoppable Force
principles.description: AI isn't going away. Like the internet, this technology is fundamentally changing the way software is built. I believe a balance between AI-driven generation and human creativity is the key to unlocking the full potential of AI in software engineering.

principles.title: The Human-in-the-Loop Designer
principles.description: The days of spending hours hand-coding CSS animations are over. AI excels at executing the repetitive, low-level tasks that used to bog us down. This frees me up to focus on the truly human elements: crafting intuitive user flows, designing visually stunning interfaces, and ensuring accessibility for all users.

principles.title: Real-Time UI & Low-Latency Streaming
principles.description: AI interfaces are evolving from static textboxes to real-time streaming canvases. Connecting live WebSocket feeds into responsive React frontends creates magical human-machine collaboration.

principles.title: Enterprise-Grade Reliability & Polish
principles.description: AI accelerates creative exploration, but strict type systems, modular SCSS tokens, and automated testing harnesses ensure enterprise applications remain rock-solid in production.

interactivePrompt.title: Ask Andy's AI Persona
interactivePrompt.placeholder: Curious how I leverage AI in my engineering process?
sampleAnswers: I leverage full-stack AI workflows to rapidly prototype backend services while focusing heavy creative effort on crafting beautiful frontend interfaces.
I have seen a 3-5x increase in productivity using AI tools, but it is important to remember that AI is a tool, not a replacement for human creativity and critical thinking.
AI has enabled me to deliver enterprise-grade web apps by combining robust backend contracts with accessible, high-performance frontend engineering.
